description: Mortar for a brick or concrete block wall: units needed, cubic feet of mortar from the Brick Industry Association quantity table (with bond-pattern correction and waste) and bags of mason mix. Formula: Brick = wall ÷ 100 × Table 4 brick per 100 sq ft × (1 + bond brick factor). Mortar (cu ft) = brick ÷ 1,000 × Table 4 cu ft per 1,000 brick for the joint × (1 + bond mortar factor) × (1 + waste). Block = wall × 1.125. Bags = units ÷ units per bag × (1 + waste).

joint_in.description: Mortar joint (brick); default 0.375; one of 0.375 = 3/8 in, 0.5 = 1/2 in

units_per_bag.description: Units per 80 lb bag (0 = 37 brick / 13 block); default 0

name: calc_mortar
title: Mortar Calculator for Brick and Block (Cubic Feet & Bags)
